title: Road conditions change during the response
description: The open road to Zone B closes after resources were recommended for INC-002; the AI-inferred Riverside Link Road is later confirmed by a field team; Zone A's road reopens.

steps.road_note: Closed by traffic police: canal overflow across the carriageway
steps.note: TC-05: the only known route used by the Zone B recommendation is now closed.

steps.road_note: Field team confirmed: road submerged near the river
steps.note: An AI-inferred potential problem becomes a KNOWN closure only once a field team confirms it.

steps.road_note: Water receded; road reopened by the traffic authority
steps.note: Improvement: access to Zone A becomes open; its access factor drops.

expected: RD-B closure is recorded as a condition change with provenance 'known' and raises a route_blocked alert
Pending/approved actions that rely on road access to Zone B are marked superseded or flagged for reassessment
A new run produces an updated plan; ground vehicles are no longer recommended for Zone B
RD-C2 changes from inferred/unknown to known/closed; the UI shows the provenance change
